findings.issue: מִנְחָה is a common noun; minjá leaves the lemma untranslated instead of a Spanish common noun.
Niphal imperfect 3fs of H644 is be baked; se cocinare widens it to generic cooking.
וְכָל־נַעֲשָׂה is a masculine substantival niphal perfect; toda hecha makes that clause feminine with the offering.

notes: Prepositions, articles, priest, hiphil bringer, object, and לוֹ תִהְיֶה match the remaining tokens.
